name: Four Seasons Hotel Abu Dhabi at Al Maryah Island

address.street: Al Maryah Island - Abu Dhabi - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: Rising from the gleaming Al Maryah Island financial district, this Four Seasons transforms a business hub into an oasis of Arabian elegance with stunning Gulf views.
whats_special: Perched on the 34th-53rd floors of a striking skyscraper, this hotel offers unparalleled panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Abu Dhabi's skyline. The property features the city's highest outdoor pool deck and houses acclaimed dining venues including Coya, bringing Peruvian-Japanese fusion to the Middle East for the first time.
pro_tip: Book a Gulf-facing room on floors 45+ for breathtaking sunset views over the water, and time your pool visits for golden hour when the city lights begin to twinkle below.
dont_miss: The rooftop Sky Bar for craft cocktails with 360-degree city views, a traditional hammam treatment at the spa, and exploring the adjacent Galleria Al Maryah Island for luxury shopping. Al Maryah Island's waterfront promenade offers perfect evening strolls with the glittering skyline as your backdrop.
pros: Prime location on Al Maryah Island with stunning waterfront views
Exceptional Four Seasons service and attention to detail
Modern luxury amenities including world-class spa and fitness facilities
Multiple dining venues with international cuisine options
cons: Business district location may feel less culturally immersive
